NO weapons, no lance, no uniform, no ghost glow, no props. Natural compact adult RPG proportions around 4.5 heads high, boots and hands easy to read, broad shoulders but not bulky. Consistent EXACT SAME outfit identity skin color and body size in every pose, no ballooning during walk. Full complete sprite sheet exactly TWELVE distinct figures arranged neatly in FOUR columns by THREE rows, generous completely empty transparent gutters so no sprites touch. Each frame same scale.
